title: recent.json
description: Recently opened books, written by RecentBooksStore (src/RecentBooksStore.cpp) to /.crosspoint/recent.json. A missing or non-array 'books' key loads as an empty list.

books.description: Most recent first. Entries past MAX_RECENT_BOOKS (10) are ignored on load.

path.description: Absolute SD path of the book file; identifies the entry.

title.description: Book title; empty until the book's metadata has been cached.

coverBmpPath.description: SD path of the cached cover thumbnail, usually under /.crosspoint/<book cache>/; empty when none.
